title: The Semantic Web
abstract_short: Vision paper for machine-readable web of data with RDF, ontologies, and software agents collaborating to perform tasks

title: Resource Description Framework (RDF) Model and Syntax Specification
abstract_short: First W3C Recommendation defining the RDF data model and XML serialization for representing metadata on the Web

title: Resource Description Framework (RDF): Concepts and Abstract Syntax
abstract_short: Defines the abstract syntax and formal semantics of RDF 1.0, establishing triples as subject-predicate-object statements

title: RDF Vocabulary Description Language 1.0: RDF Schema
abstract_short: Defines RDFS vocabulary for describing RDF classes and properties, enabling lightweight ontological modeling

title: RDF Primer
abstract_short: Tutorial introduction to RDF including basic concepts, XML syntax, vocabulary definition via RDFS, and use cases

title: Web Ontology Language: OWL
abstract_short: Comprehensive overview of OWL, the W3C standard ontology language for the Semantic Web, its species and formal underpinnings

title: OWL Web Ontology Language Reference
abstract_short: W3C Recommendation defining the complete syntax and semantics of OWL, built on Description Logic and RDF/RDFS

title: OWL 2: The next step for OWL
abstract_short: Presents OWL 2, a major revision of OWL addressing expressivity issues, syntactic problems, and species deficiencies identified in practical use

title: SPARQL Query Language for RDF
abstract_short: W3C Recommendation defining SPARQL, the standard query language for RDF with graph pattern matching, filters, and result forms

title: Linked Data - Design Issues
abstract_short: Defines four principles of Linked Data: use URIs, use HTTP URIs, provide useful information via standards, include links to other URIs

title: Linked Data - The Story So Far

abstract_short: Reviews progress in publishing Linked Data on the Web, describes the growing Web of Data, and maps out research agenda for the community

title: DBpedia: A Nucleus for a Web of Open Data
abstract_short: Presents DBpedia, a community effort to extract structured information from Wikipedia and publish it as Linked Data on the Web

abstract_short: Defines JSON-LD, a lightweight Linked Data format using JSON syntax, enabling developers to embed structured RDF data in web pages

abstract_short: Presents Knowledge Vault, a web-scale probabilistic knowledge base combining web extractions with prior knowledge from existing repositories

abstract_short: Describes Wikidata, a collaboratively edited knowledge base providing structured data for Wikipedia and external applications

title: WordNet: A Lexical Database for English

title: A Translation Approach to Portable Ontology Specifications

title: Knowledge Engineering: Principles and Methods

title: The Description Logic Handbook: Theory, Implementation and Applications

title: Formal Ontology and Information Systems

title: Freebase: A Collaboratively Created Graph Database for Structuring Human Knowledge

title: Jena: A Semantic Web Toolkit

title: The Protege Project: A Look Back and a Look Forward

title: Ontology Development 101: A Guide to Creating Your First Ontology

title: Ontology Matching: State of the Art and Future Challenges
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey of ontology matching techniques, evaluation methodology, and future challenges including large-scale and interactive matching

title: Ontology Alignment Evaluation Initiative: Six Years of Experience
abstract_short: Reports design principles, evaluation methodology, and results from OAEI campaigns 2005-2010 for benchmarking ontology matching systems

title: Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL)
abstract_short: W3C standard for validating RDF graphs against conditions expressed as shapes, providing constraint checking for knowledge graphs

title: Shape Expressions: An RDF Validation and Transformation Language

title: Foundations of RDF-star and SPARQL-star: An Alternative Approach to Statement-Level Metadata in RDF

title: Survey of Graph Database Models
abstract_short: Surveys graph database models proposed before 2002, synthesizing the notion of graph database model and comparing RDF with other approaches

title: Knowledge Graphs
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey covering knowledge graph data models, query languages, validation, deductive and inductive knowledge extraction techniques

title: BabelNet: The Automatic Construction, Evaluation and Application of a Wide-Coverage Multilingual Semantic Network
abstract_short: Presents BabelNet, automatically constructed multilingual semantic network integrating WordNet and Wikipedia with machine translation

title: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI): Generic Syntax
abstract_short: Defines the generic syntax for URIs, the fundamental identification mechanism underlying the Web and Semantic Web

title: Ontologies: A Silver Bullet for Knowledge Management and Electronic Commerce
abstract_short: Book on ontology languages (XML, RDF, OWL) and their application to knowledge management and e-commerce on the Semantic Web

title: Foundations of Semantic Web Technologies
abstract_short: Textbook covering RDF, RDFS, OWL 2, SPARQL, and RIF with formal foundations, named Outstanding Academic Title 2010

title: SKOS Simple Knowledge Organization System Reference
abstract_short: Defines SKOS vocabulary for representing thesauri, classification schemes, and taxonomies as RDF, bridging traditional KOS and Semantic Web

title: R2RML: RDB to RDF Mapping Language
abstract_short: Defines language for expressing customized mappings from relational databases to RDF datasets, enabling SPARQL access over relational data

title: Translating Embeddings for Modeling Multi-relational Data

title: Learning Entity and Relation Embeddings for Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract_short: Proposes TransR, projecting entities into relation-specific spaces before translation, improving on TransE for heterogeneous relations

title: Knowledge Bases in the Age of Big Data Analytics
abstract_short: Tutorial surveying knowledge base construction, curation, and analytics at web scale, covering extraction, fusion, and quality assessment

title: Knowledge-Based Trust: Estimating the Trustworthiness of Web Sources
abstract_short: Proposes Knowledge-Based Trust score using factual correctness to estimate web source trustworthiness, applied to 2.8B extracted facts

title: Ontology Learning and Population from Text: Algorithms, Evaluation and Applications
abstract_short: Comprehensive treatment of automatic ontology construction from text including concept extraction, taxonomy learning, and relation discovery

title: GeoSPARQL - A Geographic Query Language for RDF Data
abstract_short: OGC standard extending SPARQL with vocabulary and query functions for representing and querying geospatial RDF data

title: The Resource Description Framework (RDF) and its Vocabulary Description Language RDFS
abstract_short: Tutorial overview of RDF data model and RDFS vocabulary description language within the context of ontology engineering
